acquisition: Separate exact manifest approval and photo-specific commercially compatible rights/attribution checks before any download. No source or licensing assumed available now.
annotations: Human-reviewed whole-object native boxes, visible/occluded/truncated flags, instance/group identity, per-category completeness and unresolved regions. Missing labels never become confirmed negatives.
category_coverage: Seek at least15 photos and50 confirmed boxes per category with overlapping categories allowed; report actual support, not promised counts;120photos may be insufficient for sparse categories.
comparison: Freeze original baseline, A, B checkpoints and preprocessing before one approved evaluation. Identical prompts, confidence0.15, NMS0.5/cap300, score floor0.001, source-native matching IoU0.5/0.75; category mapping pinned before scoring.
completeness: Chair completeness explicitly includes seating/bar stools. Unresolved subtype/unit/occlusion regions excluded with coverage reported.
goal: 80%precision AND90%recall simultaneously overall and per-category with uncertainty/support; distinguish target point estimates from supported confidence bounds
matched_recall: PR-envelope comparison descriptive only; no thresholds selected or tuned on independent evaluation
partitions: New evaluation-only source groups, excluded from all optimization, negative-region annotation, threshold tuning and model/epoch selection
power_limit: 120photos/50boxes per class are a pilot, not a proof of high recall with tight uncertainty. Predefine an expansion/power plan before evaluating further checkpoints.
purpose: Independent real-room detection evaluation across seven furniture categories under commercial-compatible photograph rights
required_exclusions: all training image IDs/source URLs/hash/pixel duplicates
all known creator/source/family groups in training or development
official Phase2B holdout and existing reserved/frozen material unless separately authorized

taxonomy.Cabinet: whole cabinet/storage unit; specify built-in run treatment
taxonomy.Chair: ordinary chairs, seating stools and bar stools; footstools/ottomans/step stools separate
taxonomy.Desk/Table: define ordinary whole-object units; no automatic cross-taxonomy substitution

training_mask_boundary: Evaluation photographs and reviews can never be served by this negative-annotation tool or converted to training negatives
